prompt: Create a single transparent-background painterly game water-current detail texture, square 1024 by 1024. Reference is style/color only: subdued handpainted muted teal medieval citybuilder water. Paint many broken slender irregular pale blue-gray elongated water streaks and fine scattered foam flecks evenly distributed across canvas, each streak pointing along bottom-left to top-right diagonal at screen angle -45 degrees. Mostly empty transparent space between streaks, subtle soft edges, no underlying solid water plane, no land, no objects, no border, no text, NO LITERAL ARROWS OR CHEVRONS. Streaks have varied lengths and taper naturally like a river current, not geometrical stripes. Overall quiet restrained painterly texture, designed to shrink into a 128x64 iso water detail overlay; no glare or photorealism. Actual alpha transparency.
notes: Painterly water streaks, never graphical arrows. Iso flow is screen-space 1,-1. Apply inside water/channel mask. Direction derived by raster mirroring from one coherent painted source.

processing.alpha_cleanup: remove alpha < 80 or RGB saturation range > 65, scale alpha 0.5
processing.temporal_formula: t=k/6, translated periodic generated raster, not independent frames; t=1 equals t=0
